Jewel ACL: Precision ACL
Reconstruction for Better Recovery

Restore stability, return stronger, and protect your knee for life.

Book an Appointment

Restore stability, return stronger, and protect your knee for life.

ACL injuries are among the most common knee problems in active people and athletes. The clinic uses the Jewel ACL approach, a precise, patient-specific technique meant to restore natural knee function and support long-term joint health.

What is an ACL injury?

The anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) stabilizes the knee during sudden direction changes, pivoting and sports. A tear can cause knee instability, repeated giving way, and a higher risk of damage to the meniscus and cartilage.

What is the Jewel ACL approach?

A refined, meticulous form of ACL reconstruction in which every step is performed with precision, aiming for the best possible result.

Core principles

  • Anatomical reconstruction
  • Tissue preservation
  • Customized graft selection
  • Restoration of natural knee biomechanics

Why choose Jewel ACL?

  • More natural knee movement
  • Lower risk of graft failure
  • Faster recovery and rehabilitation
  • Better long-term joint protection

Our surgical technique

1. Anatomic tunnel placement: precise positioning helps the ligament behave naturally.

2. Personalized graft selection: the graft (hamstring, patellar or quadriceps tendon) is chosen based on your needs.

3. Meniscus preservation: the meniscus is repaired whenever possible.

4. Strong fixation methods: these allow early mobilization and faster recovery.

Rehabilitation protocol

  • Phase 1: pain control and range of motion
  • Phase 2: strength building
  • Phase 3: functional training
  • Phase 4: return to sports

Who needs ACL surgery?

Surgery is recommended for patients with knee instability, an active lifestyle, or an associated meniscus injury.
